messages:
marta: Heads-up: planning a small opt-in header change in the internal proxy that will affect SDK telemetry and route negotiation. Need eng-platform + devex alignment. TL;DR: new header X-RW-Route-Mode with values 'preferred'|'fallback'.

Yoshi: what's the compatibility risk for older SDKs? will they just omit the header?

marta: older SDKs will omit. default proxy behavior will be unchanged, but when header present we might prefer fast-path routing to instances w/ affinity. We're thinking of an opt-in flag first.

lin: concern: TS/Go SDKs that auto-instrument might start sending header without opt-in if we wire it into common client layer. Need opt-in config and a 3-release deprecation plan.

kevin: agree. also need to surface in console rollouts tile — so teams can toggle :canary: and see telemetry.

sam: on telemetry: if header present we can tag traces with route_mode. But sampling needs to be consistent; otherwise dashboards mislead. Propose adding a route_mode label to existing metric instead of new metric.

marta: good call. yoshi, can you sketch SDK shim behaviour? ideally a small fallback: if header missing, attach header when retrying on affinity-aware path.

yoshi: sketch:
```
if (opts.routeMode) {
  headers['X-RW-Route-Mode'] = opts.routeMode
} else if (retry && knownAffinity) {
  headers['X-RW-Route-Mode'] = 'preferred'
}
```

lin: + unit tests and e2e with proxy docker image. Also add env var SDK_ROUTE_MODE_OPT_IN so pkg defaults off.

kevin: console UX: add a "Route policy experiments" small tile under Deployments with on/off and sampled traffic %, and a link to changelog.

marta: rollout plan draft:
- opt-in flag in SDKs (py/ts/go) next minor
- proxy reads header only when feature gate on in console
- canary group by default 1% traffic for 48h
- expand to 10% after no regressions
- 30 days deprecation window for older clients

sam: can we also add a telemetry sanity alert: spike in 5xx or increased latency for clients with header on? deploybot can create the alert when we flip canary.

deploybot: created alert draft: "route-mode-canary-5xx-rate" -> notify #eng-oncall if 5xx>0.5% in 5m for canary group.

yoshi: docs: devex will write migration guide and snippet for each SDK. py sample should show env var and explicit opt-in. lin i'll pair on py tests.

marta: owners: SDK changes -> @yoshi; proxy + console -> @marta; telemetry alerts -> @sam; docs -> @lin. I'll open umbrella PRs and schedule a quick sync tomorrow 9:30am PT.

lin: ack. i'll stub tests and add to pipeline.

yoshi: i'll prepare changelog entries and a small compatibility note: older SDKs omit header and will still route via default policy. add note to SDKs README.

marta: perfect. thanks all :thumbsup: 

devex-bot: reminder: add a devblog entry once rollout completes and include metrics.
